<?php
class HelperToken54 {
    public function __destruct() { echo 'D|'; }
}
function Pause54($token) {
    echo 'H|';
    $received = Fiber::suspend('pause54');
    echo 'R|';
    return $received;
}
function Work54($token) {
    echo 'G|';
    $received = Pause54($token);
    echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($received === 'sent54'), '|';
    yield 'cache54';
    echo 'AFTER|';
    return 54;
}
$token = new HelperToken54();
$weak = WeakReference::create($token);
$g = Work54($token);
unset($token);
$f = new Fiber(function () {
    global $g;
    echo 'F|';
    echo 'CURRENT|', (int) ($g->current() === 'cache54'), '|';
    echo 'CALLER|';
    return 'fiber54';
});
echo 'START|', (int) ($f->start() === 'pause54'), '|';
echo 'PARKED|', (int) $f->isSuspended(), '|', (int) ($weak->get() !== null), '|';
echo 'RESUME|', (int) ($f->resume('sent54') === null), '|';
echo 'FIBER|', (int) $f->isTerminated(), '|', (int) ($f->getReturn() === 'fiber54'), '|';
echo 'CACHE|', (int) ($g->current() === 'cache54'), '|', (int) ($weak->get() !== null), '|';
$g->next();
echo 'RETURN|', (int) ($g->getReturn() === 54), '|', (int) ($weak->get() === null), '|';
unset($g, $f, $weak);
echo 'E';
